# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native single-canvas arcade keep-up game titled **Last Broadcast: Solo Queue**. Preserve the exact mechanic truth of a falling circular object that is tapped/clicked to bounce upward, score one point, wall-bounce, and fail on bottom contact. Rebuild presentation as emotional analog horror around a battle royale avatar: a lonely helmet in corrupted match footage, a storm-ring arena, dead squad portraits, scanlines, tape language, and HUD terms like Memory Saves and Signal Lost. Use procedural canvas art and mobile-readable UI. Prompt source: Create a deterministic creative remix in a analog horror style, centered on a battle royale avatar, but make it emotional. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: one-object arcade keep-up / juggling game
- objective: tap or click the falling circular object before it reaches the bottom to keep it airborne and increase score.
- input model: mouse down or touch start on the game container; UI buttons use normal click/tap.
- core loop: boot to start panel, start game, object falls under gravity, valid hit applies upward and sideways velocity, score increments, object wall-bounces, repeat until bottom collision.
- fail/friction state: failure occurs when the object's bottom passes the viewport bottom; friction gradually damps horizontal and angular velocity.

## Protected Mechanics
- Gravity constant, friction, bounce damping, kick force, circular hitbox sizing, score-per-hit semantics, wall bounce, bottom-edge failure, start and restart flow, and mobile tap support are protected.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD copy, title, typography, canvas drawing, background, particles, entity art, feedback text, catalog audio, and visual progression are safe to transform because they do not change the hit detection or state flow.
